title: Symbol lifting commutes with a step over a configuration
statement: Let $e:\\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\\to\\Gamma$ be an embedding, let $N$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine with Boolean work and input symbols, and suppose its transition action is independent of the input symbol: for every state, every two optional input symbols, and every tuple of work-tape symbols, the actions agree. Suppose also that no transition writes a blank on any work tape. For input words $x$ over $\\Gamma$ and $x'$ over the Booleans of equal length, and configurations $D$ on $x$ and $c$ on $x'$, one step of the symbol-lifted machine from the configuration obtained by lifting $c$ over $D$ equals the configuration obtained by lifting one step from $c$ over $D$.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of the Boolean symbols into $\\Gamma$
A machine with $k$ work tapes and Boolean symbols
Transition actions are independent of the input symbol
No transition writes a blank on a work tape
The two input words have equal length
A configuration over each input word
